treasureHunt.title: Treasure Hunt: The Venetian Secret of Koper
treasureHunt.shortDesc: Follow in the footsteps of a medieval Venetian merchant and uncover the secrets of Koper's streets

longDesc.part1: The treasure hunt will lead you through the streets of Koper, one of the oldest towns in Slovenia. Through fun challenges, you will
longDesc.part2: uncover clues left by the Venetian merchant Marco da Ponte,
longDesc.part3: who mysteriously left the town in 1698.
longDesc.part4: Legend has it that in his haste, he left behind a hidden treasure – a part of his wealth he couldn’t take with him.
longDesc.part5: While discovering centuries-old secrets, you'll get to know the sights and curiosities of Koper’s old town.
longDesc.part6: How does the treasure hunt work?
longDesc.part7: Purchase the treasure hunt by clicking the BUY button below. With the confirmation you receive via email, you can
longDesc.part8: pick up the treasure hunt package at the Stellaris store on Čevljarska Street,
longDesc.part9: the oldest and most famous shopping street in Koper. Everything you need for the challenge will be inside a large envelope. The instructions will guide you through tasks located throughout Koper's historic town center. If you get stuck, you can use the included hints to help solve the puzzles.
longDesc.part10: Do you dare to follow in the footsteps of the Venetian merchant Marco da Ponte and uncover the treasure?

voucher.title: Gift Voucher: Pub Quiz Ticket
voucher.shortDesc: Because time together is the most valuable present🎁

longDesc.part1: Because time together is the most valuable present 🎁
longDesc.part2: With this gift voucher – a pub quiz ticket for 4 people – you'll surprise someone special with a unique experience: an evening full of laughter, challenges, and great vibes. 💡🎲
longDesc.part3: Perfect for those who love to test their knowledge, enjoy healthy team competition, and are looking for new forms of social evenings.
longDesc.part4: After purchase, the gift voucher will be sent to your email address.
longDesc.part5: Friendly reminder: Pub quizzes are held in Slovenian.

digitalQuizGeneral.title: General Knowledge Pub Quiz for Home
digitalQuizGeneral.shortDesc: A digital general-knowledge pub quiz in Slovenian. Suitable for all generations and interest groups.

longDesc.part1: Spice up your time with friends or family with a new version of the quiz from the comfort of your living room or during a summer picnic.
longDesc.part2: The general quiz consists of 8 different categories with 6 questions each, suitable for all age groups. It also includes audio and visual content, plus an exclusive prize draw 🎁.
longDesc.part3: All you need to play is a computer, internet access, paper, and pens ✍. You'll start with brief instructions, followed by the complete quiz with all clips and answers. Just follow the presentation and enjoy! 🍻✌🏽
longDesc.part4: This quiz is not suitable for those who attended Mojster's Quiz on July 2, 2025 at Foerster.
longDesc.part5: 📧 You will receive access to the quizzes (via your email) within 24 hours of purchase. If you wish to play sooner, contact us at kviz.mojster@gmail.com.
longDesc.part6: The quizzes will be available until at least September 15, 2025.

afterPurchase.text1: By making this purchase, you have supported two local entrepreneurs — and we truly appreciate it.
afterPurchase.text2:
You can pick up the treasure hunt envelope at the Stellaris store on Čevljarska Street in Koper.

To receive it, please show the confirmation email that was sent to your email address. If you can't find the message, check your spam folder.
